question: A right prism with a rectangular base has a perimeter of 28 cm and height 12 cm. What is its lateral surface area?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Lateral Surface Area (LSA) of a prism = Perimeter of Base × Height

Base Perimeter = 28 cm

Height = 12 cm

LSA = 28 × 12 = 336 cm²

**∴ Answer = 336 cm²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Perimeter of the rectangular base = 28 cm

Height of the right prism = 12 cm

**Formula used:**

Lateral Surface Area (LSA) = Base Perimeter × Height
